verses.original: כִּֽי־ תֵ֭שֵׁב לִלְח֣וֹם אֶת־ מוֹשֵׁ֑ל בִּ֥ין תָּ֝בִ֗ין אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯê·šêḇ lil·ḥō·wm ’eṯ- mō·wō·šêl bîn tā·ḇîn ’eṯ- ’ă·šer lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: When you sit down to dine with a ruler consider carefully . . . - what is set before you

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ שַׂכִּ֣ין בְּלֹעֶ֑ךָ אִם־ אָֽתָּה׃ בַּ֖עַל נֶ֣פֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tā śak·kîn bə·lō·‘e·ḵā ’im- ’āt·tāh ba·‘al ne·p̄eš
verses.literal: and put a knife to your throat if you possess a [great] appetite

verses.original: אַל־ תִּ֭תְאָו לְמַטְעַמּוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝ה֗וּא לֶ֣חֶם כְּזָבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiṯ·ʾå̄w lə·maṭ·‘am·mō·w·ṯāw wə·hū le·ḥem kə·zā·ḇîm
verses.literal: Do not crave his delicacies for that food is deceptive

verses.original: אַל־ תִּיגַ֥ע לְֽהַעֲשִׁ֑יר מִֽבִּינָתְךָ֥ חֲדָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·ḡa‘ lə·ha·‘ă·šîr mib·bî·nā·ṯə·ḵā ḥă·ḏāl
verses.literal: Do not wear yourself out to get rich be wise enough to restrain yourself

verses.original: הֲתָעוּף עֵינֶ֥יךָ בּ֗וֹ וְֽאֵ֫ינֶ֥נּוּ כִּ֤י עָשֹׂ֣ה יַעֲשֶׂה־ לּ֣וֹ כְנָפַ֑יִם וְעָיֵף כְּ֝נֶ֗שֶׁר הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯå̄·ʿūp̄ ‘ê·ne·ḵā bōw wə·’ê·nen·nū kî ‘ā·śōh ya·‘ă·śeh- lōw ḵə·nā·p̄a·yim wə·ʿå̄·yēp̄ kə·ne·šer haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: When you glance . . . [at wealth] it disappears for it makes . . . wings for itself and flies like an eagle to the sky

verses.original: אַל־ תִּלְחַ֗ם אֶת־ לֶ֭חֶם רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְאַל־ תִּתְאָו לְמַטְעַמֹּתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- til·ḥam ’eṯ- le·ḥem ra‘ ‘ā·yin wə·’al- tiṯ·ʾå̄w lə·maṭ·‘am·mō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Do not eat - the bread of a stingy man . . . and do not crave his delicacies

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ כְּמוֹ־ שָׁעַ֥ר בְּנַפְשׁ֗וֹ כֶּ֫ן־ ה֥וּא אֱכֹ֣ל וּ֭שְׁתֵה יֹ֣אמַר לָ֑ךְ וְ֝לִבּ֗וֹ בַּל־ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî kə·mōw- šā·‘ar bə·nap̄·šōw ken- hū ’ĕ·ḵōl ū·šə·ṯêh yō·mar lāḵ wə·lib·bōw bal- ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: for - he is keeping track inwardly [counting the cost] . . . Eat and drink he says to you but his heart is not with you

verses.original: תְקִיאֶ֑נָּה פִּֽתְּךָ־ אָכַ֥לְתָּ וְ֝שִׁחַ֗תָּ הַנְּעִימִֽים׃ דְּבָרֶ֥יךָ
verses.transliteration: ṯə·qî·’en·nāh pit·tə·ḵā- ’ā·ḵal·tā wə·ši·ḥa·tā han·nə·‘î·mîm də·ḇā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: You will vomit up what little you have eaten and waste your pleasant words

verses.original: בְּאָזְנֵ֣י אַל־ תְּדַבֵּ֑ר כְ֭סִיל כִּֽי־ יָ֝ב֗וּז לְשֵׂ֣כֶל מִלֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ā·zə·nê ’al- tə·ḏab·bêr ḵə·sîl kî- yā·ḇūz lə·śê·ḵel mil·le·ḵā
verses.literal: - Do not speak to a fool for he will despise the wisdom of your words

verses.original: אַל־ תַּ֭סֵּג עוֹלָ֑ם גְּב֣וּל אַל־ תָּבֹֽא׃ וּבִשְׂדֵ֥י יְ֝תוֹמִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: ’al- tas·sêḡ ‘ō·w·lām gə·ḇūl ’al- tā·ḇō ū·ḇiś·ḏê yə·ṯō·w·mîm
verses.literal: Do not move an ancient boundary stone [or] encroach on the fields of the fatherless

verses.original: כִּֽי־ גֹאֲלָ֥ם חָזָ֑ק הֽוּא־ יָרִ֖יב אֶת־ רִיבָ֣ם אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḡō·’ă·lām ḥā·zāq hū- yā·rîḇ ’eṯ- rî·ḇām ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: for their Redeemer is strong He will take up - their case against you

verses.original: הָבִ֣יאָה לִבֶּ֑ךָ לַמּוּסָ֣ר וְ֝אָזְנֶ֗ךָ לְאִמְרֵי־ דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇî·’āh lib·be·ḵā lam·mū·sār wə·’ā·zə·ne·ḵā lə·’im·rê- ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge

verses.original: אַל־ תִּמְנַ֣ע מוּסָ֑ר מִנַּ֣עַר כִּֽי־ תַכֶּ֥נּוּ בַ֝שֵּׁ֗בֶט לֹ֣א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tim·na‘ mū·sār min·na·‘ar kî- ṯak·ken·nū ḇaš·šê·ḇeṭ lō yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Do not withhold discipline from a child although you strike him with a rod he will not die

verses.original: אַ֭תָּה תַּכֶּ֑נּוּ בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט תַּצִּֽיל׃ וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מִשְּׁא֥וֹל
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh tak·ken·nū baš·šê·ḇeṭ taṣ·ṣîl wə·nap̄·šōw miš·šə·’ō·wl
verses.literal: - Strike him with a rod and you will deliver his soul from Sheol

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אִם־ לִבֶּ֑ךָ חָכַ֣ם לִבִּ֣י גַם־ אָֽנִי׃ יִשְׂמַ֖ח
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’im- lib·be·ḵā ḥā·ḵam lib·bî ḡam- ’ā·nî yiś·maḥ
verses.literal: My son if your heart is wise my own heart will indeed . . . rejoice

verses.original: כִלְיוֹתָ֑י וְתַעְלֹ֥זְנָה שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗יךָ בְּדַבֵּ֥ר מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḵil·yō·w·ṯāy wə·ṯa‘·lō·zə·nāh śə·p̲ā·t̲ê·k̲ā bə·ḏab·bêr mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: My inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right

verses.original: אַל־ לִ֭בְּךָ יְקַנֵּ֣א בַּֽחַטָּאִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־ כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃ בְּיִרְאַת־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: ’al- lib·bə·ḵā yə·qan·nê ba·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm kî ’im- kāl- hay·yō·wm bə·yir·’aṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Do not let your heart envy sinners but . . . always continue . . . in the fear of the LORD

verses.original: כִּ֭י אִם־ יֵ֣שׁ אַחֲרִ֑ית וְ֝תִקְוָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִכָּרֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- yêš ’a·ḥă·rîṯ wə·ṯiq·wā·ṯə·ḵā lō ṯik·kā·rêṯ
verses.literal: For surely there is a future and your hope will not be cut off

verses.original: שְׁמַע־ אַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֣י וַחֲכָ֑ם וְאַשֵּׁ֖ר לִבֶּֽךָ׃ בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘- ’at·tāh ḇə·nî wa·ḥă·ḵām wə·’aš·šêr lib·be·ḵā bad·de·reḵ
verses.literal: Listen . . . my son and be wise and guide your heart on the right course

verses.original: אַל־ תְּהִ֥י בְסֹֽבְאֵי־ יָ֑יִן בְּזֹלֲלֵ֖י בָשָׂ֣ר לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·hî ḇə·sō·ḇə·’ê- yā·yin bə·zō·lă·lê ḇā·śār lā·mōw
verses.literal: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat

verses.original: כִּי־ סֹבֵ֣א וְ֭זוֹלֵל יִוָּרֵ֑שׁ נוּמָֽה׃ תַּלְבִּ֥ישׁ וּ֝קְרָעִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: kî- sō·ḇê wə·zō·w·lêl yiw·wā·rêš nū·māh tal·bîš ū·qə·rā·‘îm
verses.literal: For the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty and drowsiness will clothe them in rags

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע לְ֭אָבִיךָ זֶ֣ה יְלָדֶ֑ךָ וְאַל־ תָּ֝ב֗וּז אִמֶּֽךָ׃ כִּֽי־ זָקְנָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ lə·’ā·ḇî·ḵā zeh yə·lā·ḏe·ḵā wə·’al- tā·ḇūz ’im·me·ḵā kî- zā·qə·nāh
verses.literal: Listen to your father who gave you life and do not despise your mother when she is old

verses.original: קְ֭נֵה אֱמֶ֣ת וְאַל־ תִּמְכֹּ֑ר חָכְמָ֖ה וּמוּסָ֣ר וּבִינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qə·nêh ’ĕ·meṯ wə·’al- tim·kōr ḥāḵ·māh ū·mū·sār ū·ḇî·nāh
verses.literal: Invest in truth and never sell it in wisdom and instruction and understanding

verses.original: אֲבִ֣י צַדִּ֑יק גּוֹל יָגוֹל יוֹלֵד חָ֝כָ֗ם וְיִשְׂמַח בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇî ṣad·dîq gōl yå̄·ḡōl yō·lēḏ ḥā·ḵām wə·yiś·maḥ bōw
verses.literal: The father of a righteous man will greatly rejoice . . . and he who fathers a wise son will delight in him . . .

verses.original: אָבִ֥יךָ וְאִמֶּ֑ךָ יִֽשְׂמַח־ יֽוֹלַדְתֶּֽךָ׃ וְ֝תָגֵ֗ל
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’im·me·ḵā yiś·maḥ- yō·w·laḏ·te·ḵā wə·ṯā·ḡêl
verses.literal: May your father and mother be glad and may she who gave you birth rejoice

verses.original: בְנִ֣י תְּנָֽה־ לִבְּךָ֣ לִ֑י וְ֝עֵינֶ֗יךָ תִּרְצֶנָה׃ דְּרָכַ֥י
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nî tə·nāh- lib·bə·ḵā lî wə·‘ê·ne·ḵā tir·ṣɛ·nå̄h də·rā·ḵay
verses.literal: My son give me your heart and let your eyes delight in my ways

verses.original: כִּֽי־ זוֹנָ֑ה עֲמֻקָּ֣ה שׁוּחָ֣ה נָכְרִיָּֽה׃ צָ֝רָ֗ה וּבְאֵ֥ר
verses.transliteration: kî- zō·w·nāh ‘ă·muq·qāh šū·ḥāh nā·ḵə·rî·yāh ṣā·rāh ū·ḇə·’êr
verses.literal: For a prostitute is a deep pit and an adulteress is a narrow well

verses.original: כְּחֶ֣תֶף אַף־ הִ֭יא תֶּֽאֱרֹ֑ב תּוֹסִֽף׃ וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים בְּאָדָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: kə·ḥe·ṯep̄ ’ap̄- hî te·’ĕ·rōḇ tō·w·sip̄ ū·ḇō·wḡ·ḏîm bə·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Like a robber - she lies in wait and multiplies the faithless among men

verses.original: לְמִ֨י א֥וֹי לְמִ֪י אֲב֡וֹי לְמִ֤י מְדוֹנִים לְמִ֥י שִׂ֗יחַ לְ֭מִי חִנָּ֑ם פְּצָעִ֣ים לְ֝מִ֗י חַכְלִל֥וּת עֵינָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·mî ’ō·w lə·mî ’ă·ḇō·w lə·mî mə·ḏō·nīm lə·mî śî·aḥ lə·mî ḥin·nām pə·ṣā·‘îm lə·mî ḥaḵ·li·lūṯ ‘ê·nā·yim
verses.literal: Who has woe Who has sorrow Who has contentions Who has complaints Who {has} needless wounds Who has bloodshot eyes

verses.original: לַֽמְאַחֲרִ֥ים עַל־ הַיָּ֑יִן לַ֝בָּאִ֗ים לַחְקֹ֥ר מִמְסָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·’a·ḥă·rîm ‘al- hay·yā·yin lab·bā·’îm laḥ·qōr mim·sāḵ
verses.literal: Those who linger over wine who go to taste mixed drinks

verses.original: אַל־ תֵּ֥רֶא יַיִן֮ כִּ֪י יִתְאַ֫דָּ֥ם כִּֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן בַּכִּיס עֵינ֑וֹ יִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tê·re ya·yin kî yiṯ·’ad·dām kî- yit·tên bak·kīs ‘ê·nōw yiṯ·hal·lêḵ bə·mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: Do not gaze at wine while it is red when it sparkles in the cup . . . and goes down smoothly . . .

verses.original: אַ֭חֲרִיתוֹ יִשָּׁ֑ךְ כְּנָחָ֣שׁ יַפְרִֽשׁ׃ וּֽכְצִפְעֹנִ֥י
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rî·ṯōw yiš·šāḵ kə·nā·ḥāš yap̄·riš ū·ḵə·ṣip̄·‘ō·nî
verses.literal: In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper

verses.original: עֵ֭ינֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּ זָר֑וֹת וְ֝לִבְּךָ֗ יְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ne·ḵā yir·’ū zā·rō·wṯ wə·lib·bə·ḵā yə·ḏab·bêr tah·pu·ḵō·wṯ
verses.literal: Your eyes will see strange things and your mind will utter perversities

verses.original: וְ֭הָיִיתָ כְּשֹׁכֵ֣ב בְּלֶב־ יָ֑ם וּ֝כְשֹׁכֵ֗ב בְּרֹ֣אשׁ חִבֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yî·ṯā kə·šō·ḵêḇ bə·leḇ- yām ū·ḵə·šō·ḵêḇ bə·rōš ḥib·bêl
verses.literal: You will be like one sleeping . . . on the high seas or lying on the top of a mast

verses.original: הִכּ֥וּנִי בַל־ חָלִיתִי֮ הֲלָמ֗וּנִי בַּל־ יָ֫דָ֥עְתִּי מָתַ֥י אָקִ֑יץ אֲבַקְשֶׁ֥נּוּ א֝וֹסִ֗יף עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: hik·kū·nî ḇal- ḥā·lî·ṯî hă·lā·mū·nî bal- yā·ḏā·‘ə·tî mā·ṯay ’ā·qîṣ ’ă·ḇaq·šen·nū ’ō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: They struck me but I feel no pain They beat me but I did not know it! When can I wake up to search for another drink
